summary: Verified compact office marker change on /project-map at mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x1080). Office marker is a 28x28 icon-only orange pill with building SVG (no text). Office card opens on click with all required content (MY DREAM PROJECTS / OFFICE / STUDIO / Ameenpur / Get Directions / Contact Us). GET DIRECTIONS href is a google.com/maps URL with ftid=0x3bcb8d6d4959d47b. CONTACT US navigates to /contact. Office persists under all three filters (all/completed/ongoing). No horizontal overflow. Zero page errors. Project markers = 19 total (all filter), 13 completed (desktop), 6 ongoing on both viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectMap.jsx duplicates the office-marker className string in both the marker-creation useEffect and the highlight useEffect (lines ~421 and ~450). Consider extracting to a constant to avoid future drift.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compact office marker verified on both mobile and desktop. Mobile filter test observed project_markers=19 for the 'completed' filter mid-transition (likely a race in the count-poll immediately after clicking), but the visible ONGOING filter subsequently reduced correctly to 6 and desktop showed 13 for completed as expected — treated as harmless test timing, not a bug. Filter counter labels (ALL 19 / COMPLETED 13 / ONGOING 06) are correctly hardcoded in the buttons and office is excluded from those counts.
